course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Defend a solution: find the customer lost by a query
goal: Defend an independent configuration or extension, fix a transfer defect and prove recovery.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P11. Preserve accepted work, sources and a DT; distinguish common-module and application roles.

sections.title: Where the question starts
paragraphs: The report shows 440 minutes, but one customer is missing. The total looks right; is the report correct? Find a distinguishing case and show which query clause changes the result.

sections.title: Preserve accepted work and choose your own copy
paragraphs: First preserve accepted P11 work, sources and a DT. Run P12 in a separate new file infobase containing only the 12 invented requests. Initially transfer your metadata into a new empty infobase; never load a CF over prior work. Create the 30, 45, 15, 0, 60, 20, 25, 35, 40, 50, 55, 65 dataset exactly once. If records already exist, do not repeat seed.

Data functions belong to own server common module УчебнаяИтоговая: Server/Server call enabled; Client/Global/Privileged disabled. Приложение.bsl belongs to the separate client application module. Preserve the prior handler and remove only the added call after the experiment. Neither delete nor duplicate old definitions.

sections.title: Projects test the complete chain
paragraphs: A learner chooses service, warehouse, HR documents or synthetic finance. Requirements define model, operations, reports, invariants and admission. Use no real data or proprietary configurations. Study maintenance through an original training application and synthetic cases.

Open Nexus programming 1C → Final assessment. Three theory variants, four practices and one of three projects have separate criteria. Read the selected variant before changing the infobase; retain attempt IDs/history. The application-course final does not substitute for programming.

sections.title: Complete source of the worked action
paragraphs: The dataset has three customers: two with six requests each and one with none. The first and third share a name but have different references. INNER JOIN returns two rows; LEFT JOIN returns three, with zero requests for the empty customer. The total stays 440. Correcting membership need not change a total.
Files below belong to their respective modules. Source, loading and observation after running are separate stages.

sections.title: Walk through the action and result
paragraphs: The dataset has three customers: two with six requests each and one with none. The first and third share a name but have different references. INNER JOIN returns two rows; LEFT JOIN returns three, with zero requests for the empty customer. The total stays 440. Correcting membership need not change a total.
Read every result label and identify the specific comparison it establishes. A successful run by itself does not establish the requirement.

The supplied BSL deliberately uses the author’s Russian message literals, so the output below retains those exact literals. The English explanation above describes their meaning; it does not translate the program’s actual output.

tables.caption: Expectation and observation
rows: The dataset has three customers: two with six requests each and one with none. The first and third share a name but have different references. Both queries ran in a separate synthetic infobase. Observations show 2 → 3 customers and 1 → 0 requests for the empty customer; records were not changed. These are specific property checks, not proof of authorship, an official qualification or assessment of every project part.

sections.title: Present independence honestly
paragraphs: Declare templates, permitted ideas, own changes and assistance. Review ties explanation to actual code, tests and results. Local reports are editable and cannot establish authorship. Native PASS confirms named assertions, not professional status or an official certificate.

The Training service desk project connects model, write/rejection, posting/reposting, query/report and recovery. Choose a bounded discriminating change such as fixing an empty-customer loss or duplicate movements. Keep reproduction, own correction, both sources and the distinguishing test.

sections.title: Your prediction before running
paragraphs: LEFT JOIN restores the empty customer. Will the 440 total change when that customer has zero minutes?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: The total remains 440 while the third specific reference returns. That distinguishes list completeness. Looking up only a name is insufficient because two customers share it. State the requirement to include customers with no requests before changing the query.

sections.title: A transfer defect checks understanding
paragraphs: For example, reposting doubles a total or aJOINloses a request-free customer. Reproduce, form a hypothesis and write a discriminating test first. Fix a new copy and repeat baseline cases. Transfer work must not overwrite an accepted submission or erase attempts.

In 5–7 minutes show actual references/numbers, code location, architectural reasons and an independent control change in another copy. Explain one rejection and restoration. Another person’s screenshot or an autogenerated protocol proves no authorship; disclose Akronikl/other help honestly.

sections.title: How state changes
paragraphs: The defects differ: INNER loses a row; COUNT(*) miscounts the empty LEFT JOIN row. Each needs its own observation. Group by reference so matching names do not merge customers.

sections.title: When a plausible result is wrong
paragraphs: After LEFT JOIN, COUNT(*) reports one request for the empty customer. The join retained a customer row, but it contains no related document. Count document references using КОЛИЧЕСТВО(З.Ссылка), rather than every joined row.

sections.title: A defense ends with a reproducible package
paragraphs: Submit requirements, diagram, source SHA, dataset, positive/negative tests, performance conditions and recovery. Identify environment limits and untested areas. Pdoes not substitute forAor vice versa; a copy may share the domain model but meets independent criteria and records its own outcome.

Submit requirements, sources, versions/SHA, synthetic input or creation steps, tests, limits and rollback. Redistribute no platform installer or third-party configuration. Local self-reported progress is not certification or server code grading. Keep accepted and control copies separate.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: Using the same three own customers, reproduce another defect: COUNT(*) incorrectly gives the empty customer one request. Change it to КОЛИЧЕСТВО(З.Ссылка). Show both rows for that same reference: 1 → 0, with 12 requests and 440 minutes overall. Keep both versions and explain why the first INNER JOIN test did not check this counter.
Preserve your attempt and prediction first. The reference is available on request and does not replace your work.
